plans.idea: Keep the original's left-to-right story at strip scale: the stacked logo at full height on the left, headline over subheadline in a wide centre column, and the 'See All Events' button in its own vertically centred slot at the right, instead of the engine's tiny pill tucked under the copy.

Headline-first leaderboard: the headline and subheadline open at the left edge where the eye lands, then the brand mark sits as a sign-off, and the button closes the row at the right, so the order reads message, brand, action.

Centred cluster: logo, copy and button are drawn in from both ends with equal outer whitespace and share a single horizontal axis, so the group reads as one block in the middle of the wide strip rather than three pieces pushed to the edges.
